Each entry is one reviewed edition of a file whose sha256 an active run manifest binds. Growth of an existing run across two editions is eligible only when BOTH hashes are listed here, and is trusted only after every stored catalog row re-renders byte-identically under the exporting code. Only hashes actually bound by a run manifest, plus the current edition, belong here; unlisted drift fails closed.
